guide.page_title: How to use Active Recall Learning

what.title: What is Active Recall Learning?
what.body: Active recall is a learning method that strengthens memory by actively retrieving what you have learned. Write today's reflection, then on subsequent days try to recall the content from memory before checking your answers.

theme.title: Create a Theme
theme.body: A "theme" is the unit of your reflections. Create themes for subjects, qualifications, projects, a diary, or anything you want to keep reviewing. You can link a theme to a timetable slot or use it as a free-standing theme.

today.title: Write Today's Reflection
today.body: The "Today's reflections" view lists the day's slots and themes. Open each card, write what you learned and any insights, then save.

recall.title: Recall Test (Retrieval Practice)
recall.body: From the next day onwards, your written content is automatically hidden. Try to recall it in your own words, then reveal the original to check yourself. The effort of recalling strengthens your memory.

reminder.title: Reminders and Calendar
reminder.body: You will receive notifications when it is time to review. Days on which you wrote a reflection are marked in My Calendar, so you can see your progress at a glance.
